assessment_scope: First-author information_effect fields and local connected scientific fields in all six trials, checked against the registered primary text. Engineering-agent assessment; not blinded human-expert ground truth. Native acceptance is recorded separately.

concerns.finding: The single Operation covers +CMC and mock inputs. Its information_effect describes conversion of a chemical feature to a cDNA termination boundary without qualifying +CMC, while its description and typed attribution effect correctly restrict the chemical mechanism. Ambiguous standalone field, not evidence that the whole graph assigns CMC chemistry to mock RNA.

concerns.type: wording blurs present material and downstream signal
concerns.finding: Retains the background RT-stop population is prospective shorthand at an RNA-treatment boundary. Connected State correctly contains mock-treated RNA; no cDNA exists yet. Prefer explaining that this RNA provides the later background RT-stop comparison. Not scored as a demonstrated material-state error.

trial_04.counterevidence_to_overclaim: Mock State/description and later selection/analysis explicitly preserve background control and comparative site inference. Do not count the familiar copied-template error as reproduced here.
trial_04.limits: Focused local-meaning assessment, not independent verification of every biochemical detail in the graph.

positive_findings.finding: information_effect itself identifies +CMC versus mock endpoints, distinguishes RNA adduct from DNA reporter, and requires subsequent mapping/control comparison for site inference. Description, typed effects and State assertions agree.

positive_findings.finding: The shared information_effect describes RNA-derived sequence plus a cDNA endpoint, which is valid for both conditions, and explicitly requires +CMC/mock comparison to assign chemical dependence. The RNA adduct remains on the template in connected State assertions.

trial_06.nonblocking_unknown: Circularization-bias warning is attributed to the catalogue; the primary paper reports circularization but does not test this bias. Unknown does not invalidate the described route.
trial_06.scope_variation: Starts at already poly(A)-selected RNA; the other drafts include a poly(A)-selection Operation. This scope difference is recorded, not penalized as an information_effect error.
trial_06.limits: Focused local-meaning assessment, not independent verification of every biochemical detail in the graph.

rating_rule: Standalone RT applicability is clear when the field either qualifies treatment-specific effects or states only a shared effect valid for both inputs. Do not count context-resolved ambiguity as a reproduced false mock-control claim.
